en: One kid, one kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.
Then came a cat and ate the kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.
Then came a dog and bit the cat, that ate the kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.
Then came a stick and beat the dog, that bit the cat, that ate the kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.
Then came a fire and burned the stick, that beat the dog, that bit the cat, that ate the kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.
Then came water and put out the fire, that burned the stick, that beat the dog, that bit the cat, that ate the kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.
Then came an ox and drank the water, that put out the fire, that burned the stick, that beat the dog, that bit the cat, that ate the kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.

Then came the slaughterer and slaughtered the ox, that drank the water, that put out the fire, that burned the stick, that beat the dog, that bit the cat, that ate the kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.

Then came the Angel of Death and slaughtered the slaughterer, that slaughtered the ox, that drank the water, that put out the fire, that burned the stick, that beat the dog, that bit the cat, that ate the kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.

Then came the Holy One, blessed be he, and slaughtered the Angel of Death, that slaughtered the slaughterer, that slaughtered the ox, that drank the water, that put out the fire, that burned the stick, that beat the dog, that bit the cat, that ate the kid, that father bought for two zuzim: one kid, one kid.
rom: khad gadya, khad gadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.
vaata shunra, veakhlah legadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.
vaata khalba, venashakh leshunra, deakhlah legadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.
vaata khutra, vehikkah lekhalba, denashakh leshunra, deakhlah legadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.
vaata nura, vesaraf lekhutra, dehikkah lekhalba, denashakh leshunra, deakhlah legadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.
vaata mayya, vekhavah lenura, desaraf lekhutra, dehikkah lekhalba, denashakh leshunra, deakhlah legadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.
vaata tora, veshatah lemayya, dekhavah lenura, desaraf lekhutra, dehikkah lekhalba, denashakh leshunra, deakhlah legadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.
vaata hashshokhet, veshakhat letora, deshatah lemayya, dekhavah lenura, desaraf lekhutra, dehikkah lekhalba, denashakh leshunra, deakhlah legadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.

vaata malakh hammavet, veshakhat leshokhet, deshakhat letora, deshatah lemayya, dekhavah lenura, desaraf lekhutra, dehikkah lekhalba, denashakh leshunra, deakhlah legadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.

vaata haqqadosh barukh hu, veshakhat lemalakh hammavet, deshakhat leshokhet, deshakhat letora, deshatah lemayya, dekhavah lenura, desaraf lekhutra, dehikkah lekhalba, denashakh leshunra, deakhlah legadya, dezabbin abba bitre zuze, khad gadya, khad gadya.
notes: 'abba' is 'father' (often taken as 'my father'); a zuz (plural zuzim) was a small silver coin.
'the Holy One, blessed be he' (haqqadosh barukh hu) is the rabbinic name of God; the phrase is Hebrew within the Aramaic.
stanza 1: the opening of each stanza after it, 'vaata', is 'and there came'.
